title: Cosmo checks a picture before posting: how suggestive, how old it looks, where it can go
description: Fabio, 2026-10-13: users who post adult work need to know what Instagram allows vs explicit sites, and that nothing reading under 18 goes anywhere. Built as one app guide for Cosmo (docs/agent/posting-check.md, served as app:posting-check through the knowledge index Cosmo already gets): one look with a fixed question set (skin, exposed parts, pose, camera, age), a four-tier verdict (safe / suggestive / explicit / reads under 18), guidance not a ruling, and a failed look reported as not checked. No code.
